slots.name: support programs
slots.sentence: The Fostering Academics, Mentoring Excellence (FAME) program at MSU is one of about two dozen support programs at colleges and universities in the state dedicated to helping former foster youth on campus.

slots.name: legislation status
slots.sentence: Schmaltz co-sponsored legislation with Sen Jeff Irwin, D-Ann Arbor, that was signed into law and requires that a significant amount of federal money received for a foster child be preserved for their future needs.

slots.name: tuition waiver states
slots.sentence: Michigan does provide financial support. It’s one of about 26 states that offer tuition and fee waivers for former foster youth. Seven states, including Minnesota and Iowa, go a step further and cover more costs of attending college.
